errors.evidence: The pie chart clearly shows four sectors, not five.
The chart and its legend do not include a category called 'Други' (Others).

errors.text_span: Секторът „Клиент/Възложител“ заема най-голям дял, представлявайки приблизително 47.6% от общия брой отговори.
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly maps the category 'Клиент/Възложител' to the 47.6% share. In the chart, 'Клиент/Възложител' is the blue slice, which corresponds to 14.3%. The 47.6% share belongs to the green slice, which is 'Строител'.

errors.text_span: Следващият по големина сектор е „Строител“, който обхваща около 33.3% от анкетираните.
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly maps the category 'Строител' to the 33.3% share. In the chart, 'Строител' is the green slice, which has the largest share at 47.6%. The 33.3% share belongs to 'Проектант' (red slice).

The description incorrectly maps the category 'Проектант' to the 14.3% share. In the chart, 'Проектант' is the red slice, which corresponds to 33.3%. The 14.3% share belongs to 'Клиент/Възложител' (blue slice).

The chart does not show a percentage label for the 'Консултант/Надзор' category (yellow slice). The value is not 11.8%. The correct value, calculated from the others, would be 100 - 47.6 - 33.3 - 14.3 = 4.8%.
